name: liquid-voice
title: Liquid Voice
description: A voice-input pill of real liquid glass that stretches into a recorder.
docs:
Liquid Voice — A voice-input pill of real liquid glass that stretches into a recorder.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is set in the system's own UI face, so there is no font to load.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.

The glass is drawn in WebGL 2; without it the component falls back to a CSS gradient and backdrop-filter glass on its own. There is no microphone: the waveform is generated. Wire onSend and onCancel to your own recorder if you need real audio. Pass fill to have the sky take its container's whole box.
